defaults.description: Explore the diverse geography of {name} through our highly optimized, interactive SVG map. Perfect for dashboards, data visualization, and regional targeting.

maps.name: Haiti
maps.description: Haiti is a Caribbean nation sharing the island of Hispaniola, celebrated as the world's first independent black republic, with a rich history, vibrant art, and resilient culture.

maps.name: Honduras
maps.description: Honduras is a Central American country known for its rugged Caribbean and Pacific coastlines, lush rainforests, and the ancient Mayan ruins of Copán.

maps.name: Iceland
maps.description: Iceland is a Nordic island nation in the North Atlantic, famously known as the 'Land of Fire and Ice' for its dramatic volcanoes, geysers, hot springs, and lava fields.

maps.name: Jamaica
maps.description: Jamaica is a vibrant Caribbean island nation, globally renowned as the birthplace of reggae music, with lush mountainous interiors, waterfalls, and stunning white-sand beaches.

maps.name: Kyrgyzstan
maps.description: Kyrgyzstan is a landlocked country in Central Asia, dominated by the majestic Tian Shan mountains, pristine alpine lakes like Issyk-Kul, and a rich, enduring nomadic heritage.

maps.name: Laos
maps.description: Laos is a landlocked Southeast Asian country characterized by its rugged mountainous terrain, the mighty Mekong River, French colonial architecture, and serene Buddhist temples.

maps.name: Lesotho
maps.description: Lesotho is an independent, landlocked kingdom entirely surrounded by South Africa, known as the 'Kingdom in the Sky' due to its high elevation and the spectacular Maloti Mountains.

maps.name: Liberia
maps.description: Liberia is a West African country with a unique history as a settlement for freed American slaves, featuring dense rainforests, a rich cultural tapestry, and a resilient national spirit.

maps.name: Liechtenstein
maps.description: Liechtenstein is a tiny, prosperous Alpine principality nestled between Switzerland and Austria, famous for its medieval castles, picturesque villages, and stunning mountain landscapes.

maps.name: Luxembourg
maps.description: Luxembourg is a small, landlocked Western European grand duchy, known for its fortified medieval old town perched on rocky gorges, lush forests, and its role as a major financial hub.

maps.name: Macedonia
maps.description: Macedonia (North Macedonia) is a landlocked country in the Balkan peninsula, known for its ancient history, dramatic mountains, and the UNESCO World Heritage site of Lake Ohrid.

maps.name: Madagascar
maps.description: Madagascar is a large island nation in the Indian Ocean, globally famous for its unique biodiversity, including lemurs and baobab trees, found nowhere else on Earth.

maps.name: Malawi
maps.description: Malawi is a landlocked country in southeastern Africa, affectionately known as the 'Warm Heart of Africa' for its friendly people and the stunning, clear waters of Lake Malawi.

maps.name: Maldives
maps.description: The Maldives is a tropical island nation in the Indian Ocean, renowned worldwide for its luxury overwater resorts, pristine white-sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs.

maps.name: Mali
maps.description: Mali is a landlocked West African country, historically significant as the heart of the ancient Mali Empire, and known for the historic city of Timbuktu and the Niger River.

maps.name: Malta
maps.description: Malta is a small, densely populated island country in the central Mediterranean, famous for its rich history, fortified medieval cities, and ancient megalithic temples.

maps.name: Mauritania
maps.description: Mauritania is a large country in Northwest Africa, largely covered by the Sahara Desert, known for its ancient Saharan trading posts, iron ore reserves, and Atlantic coastline.

maps.name: Mauritius
maps.description: Mauritius is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, celebrated for its stunning beaches, turquoise lagoons, extensive coral reefs, and a harmonious multicultural society.

maps.name: Moldova
maps.description: Moldova is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe, known for its rolling hills, extensive and historic wine cellars, and a rich, traditional agricultural heritage.

maps.name: Monaco
maps.description: Monaco is a tiny, sovereign city-state on the French Riviera, globally famous for its upscale casinos, yacht-lined harbor, prestigious Grand Prix, and glamorous lifestyle.

maps.name: Mongolia
maps.description: Mongolia is a vast, landlocked country in East Asia, famous for its expansive steppes, rich nomadic heritage, and the legacy of the historic Mongol Empire.

maps.name: Montenegro
maps.description: Montenegro is a small Balkan country on the Adriatic Sea, known for its dramatic mountains, medieval villages, and the stunning, fjord-like Bay of Kotor.

maps.name: Montserrat
maps.description: Montserrat is a small Caribbean island and British Overseas Territory, known as the 'Emerald Isle of the Caribbean' for its Irish heritage and lush, volcanic landscape.

maps.name: Namibia
maps.description: Namibia is a country in Southern Africa characterized by the arid Namib Desert along its Atlantic coastline, diverse wildlife, and striking red sand dunes.

maps.name: Nauru
maps.description: Nauru is a tiny island country in Micronesia, known for its raised coral atoll, phosphate mining history, and unique, isolated Pacific culture.

maps.name: New_caledonia
maps.description: New Caledonia is a French special collectivity in the southwest Pacific, renowned for its immense barrier reef, diverse indigenous Kanak culture, and lush landscapes.

maps.name: Nicaragua
maps.description: Nicaragua is the largest country in Central America, known as the 'Land of Lakes and Volcanoes' for its stunning natural geography, colonial cities, and rich biodiversity.

maps.name: Niger
maps.description: Niger is a landlocked country in West Africa, largely covered by the Sahara Desert, known for its ancient rock art, the W National Park, and the Niger River.

maps.name: North_korea
maps.description: North Korea is a country in East Asia, known for its highly centralized government, distinctive monumental architecture in Pyongyang, and rugged mountainous terrain.

maps.name: Panama
maps.description: Panama is a Central American country famous for the Panama Canal, which connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, as well as its vibrant capital city and rich tropical biodiversity.

maps.name: Papua New Guinea
maps.description: Papua New Guinea is an Oceanian country occupying the eastern half of the island of New Guinea, renowned for its incredible linguistic diversity, rich tribal cultures, and unique wildlife like the bird of paradise.

maps.name: Paraguay
maps.description: Paraguay is a landlocked country in the heart of South America, known for its strong Guarani cultural heritage, the vast Gran Chaco region, and the mighty Paraguay River.

maps.name: Pitcairn Islands
maps.description: The Pitcairn Islands are a remote British Overseas Territory in the South Pacific, famously known as the final refuge of the HMS Bounty mutineers and their Tahitian companions.

maps.name: Republic of Congo
maps.description: The Republic of the Congo is a Central African nation located on the equator, known for its dense Congo Basin rainforests, diverse wildlife, and vibrant cultural traditions.

maps.name: Rwanda
maps.description: Rwanda is a small, landlocked country in East Africa, famously known as the 'Land of a Thousand Hills' and celebrated for its mountain gorilla conservation efforts and remarkable post-genocide recovery.

maps.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
maps.description: Saint Kitts and Nevis is a dual-island nation in the Caribbean, known for its historic Brimstone Hill Fortress, lush rainforests, and beautiful black-sand beaches.

maps.name: Saint Lucia
maps.description: Saint Lucia is a volcanic island nation in the Caribbean, globally famous for its iconic, towering Pitons, lush rainforests, and vibrant Creole culture.

maps.name: Saint Martin (Dutch)
maps.description: Sint Maarten is the Dutch constituent country occupying the southern part of the Caribbean island of Saint Martin, famous for its duty-free shopping, vibrant nightlife, and the unique Maho Beach.

maps.name: Saint Martin (French)
maps.description: Saint Martin is the French overseas collectivity occupying the northern part of the Caribbean island, celebrated for its pristine beaches, gourmet French-Creole cuisine, and tranquil atmosphere.

maps.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
maps.description: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is a Caribbean nation consisting of the main island of Saint Vincent and a chain of smaller islands, renowned as a world-class sailing destination with lush volcanic landscapes.

maps.name: São Tomé and Príncipe
maps.description: São Tomé and Príncipe is a small island nation in the Gulf of Guinea, known for its lush rainforests, pristine beaches, and historic Portuguese colonial architecture.

maps.name: Seychelles
maps.description: Seychelles is an archipelago of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean, globally celebrated for its rare wildlife, pristine coral reefs, and iconic granite rock formations.

maps.name: Sierra Leone
maps.description: Sierra Leone is a West African country known for its beautiful Atlantic coastline, rich diamond mining history, and resilient, vibrant cultural communities.

maps.name: Solomon Islands
maps.description: The Solomon Islands is an Oceanian country consisting of nearly 1,000 islands, famous for its World War II historical sites, incredible marine biodiversity, and traditional Melanesian culture.

maps.name: Somalia
maps.description: Somalia is a country in the Horn of Africa with the longest coastline on the continent, known for its rich pastoral heritage, ancient cave paintings, and strategic maritime location.

maps.name: South Sudan
maps.description: South Sudan is a landlocked country in East-Central Africa, characterized by vast swamps, the White Nile, and diverse ethnic groups with rich cultural traditions.

maps.name: Suriname
maps.description: Suriname is a small country on the northeastern coast of South America, renowned for its vast, untouched Amazon rainforest and highly diverse, multicultural population.

maps.name: Swaziland
maps.description: Eswatini (formerly Swaziland) is a small, landlocked kingdom in Southern Africa, famous for its traditional Swazi culture, wildlife reserves, and scenic mountain landscapes.

maps.name: Tajikistan
maps.description: Tajikistan is a landlocked, mountainous country in Central Asia, dominated by the Pamir Mountains and known for its ancient Silk Road history and resilient, hospitable people.

maps.name: The Gambia
maps.description: The Gambia is the smallest country on mainland Africa, uniquely defined by the Gambia River that flows through its center, known for its rich birdlife and friendly coastal communities.

maps.name: Timor-leste
maps.description: Timor-Leste is a Southeast Asian nation occupying the eastern half of the island of Timor, known for its rich cultural heritage, pristine coral reefs, and resilient history.

maps.name: Togo
maps.description: Togo is a narrow West African country known for its palm-lined beaches, vibrant voodoo culture, and the scenic, rolling landscapes of the Togo Mountains.

maps.name: Tonga
maps.description: Tonga is a Polynesian kingdom in the South Pacific, famous for its untouched coral reefs, traditional wooden architecture, and being the first country to see the new day.

maps.name: Trinidad_and_tobago
maps.description: Trinidad and Tobago is a twin-island Caribbean nation renowned as the birthplace of calypso and steelpan music, with rich biodiversity and vibrant carnival traditions.

maps.name: Turkmenistan
maps.description: Turkmenistan is a Central Asian country largely covered by the Karakum Desert, known for its ancient Silk Road cities like Merv and the famous Darvaza gas crater.

maps.name: Turks_and_caicos_islands
maps.description: The Turks and Caicos Islands are a British Overseas Territory in the Atlantic Ocean, celebrated for their stunning white-sand beaches, crystal-clear waters, and world-class snorkeling.

maps.name: United_states_virgin_islands
maps.description: The United States Virgin Islands are a group of Caribbean islands and an unincorporated territory of the US, known for beautiful beaches, historic sugar plantations, and vibrant marine life.

maps.name: Uruguay
maps.description: Uruguay is a South American country known for its progressive policies, scenic coastal resorts like Punta del Este, and a rich gaucho and tango heritage.

maps.name: Uzbekistan
maps.description: Uzbekistan is a doubly landlocked country in Central Asia, famous for its stunning Islamic architecture and ancient Silk Road cities like Samarkand, Bukhara, and Khiva.

maps.name: Vanuatu
maps.description: Vanuatu is a South Pacific island nation known for its active volcanoes, pristine coral reefs, shipwreck diving sites, and rich, diverse Melanesian cultures.

maps.name: Vatican
maps.description: Vatican City is an independent city-state enclaved within Rome, Italy, serving as the spiritual and administrative headquarters of the Roman Catholic Church and home to iconic art and architecture.

maps.name: Western Sahara
maps.description: Western Sahara is a sparsely populated territory in North Africa, largely covered by the Sahara Desert, known for its rugged Atlantic coastline and complex geopolitical status.
